title: Zesty Spanish Falafel Patatas Bravas
description: A peppery and snappy Spanish dish featuring falafel in a patatas bravas style, served in an earthenware bowl and halal friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the diced potatoes in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the falafel mix, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and chili flakes.
Using a bain marie, heat the falafel mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until it is warmed through.
In a separate saucepan, heat the tomato sauce over medium heat until it is warm and bubbly.
To assemble the dish, place a layer of potatoes in the bottom of an earthenware bowl, followed by a layer of the falafel mixture, and then a layer of the tomato sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of tomato sauce on top.
Place the earthenware bowl in the oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is lightly browned.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
